id: title:jabahamondes:serve frontend public over static in dev so runtime asset paths resolve

review.posthog_relevance: Allows Django development server to serve static assets located in frontend/public, addressing a missing-path issue for warehouse source icons and CDP destination images that are not bundled and thus not copied to frontend/dist.
review.reason: Adds a conditional DEBUG-only STATICFILES_DIRS entry pointing to frontend/public, while retaining the existing production dist path. This could prevent silent image failures in the UI when these assets are requested as strings in API payloads.
review.uncertainty: The benefit is contingent on the existence of un-bundled assets and their request patterns, which are not independently verified; the score is assigned based on the potential utility of the configuration rather than observed runtime behavior.

observations.limitations: This chunk contains only one hunk. No other hunks are supplied, so no relationship between multiple hunks or broader change group can be established. No score is assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a conditional DEBUG-only STATICFILES_DIRS entry pointing to frontend/public, while retaining the existing production dist path.
